description: A tiny end-to-end implementation that exercises every architectural layer. It proves the decisions fit together before features are added.
The data shaped for one screen: only the fields the UI renders, already formatted. Produced by the BFF.
Server data serialized into the HTML (`<script type="application/json">`) so the client hydrates without fetching it again.
JSON with `<` escaped as `\u003c`, so data cannot close the surrounding `<script>` tag while `JSON.parse` still returns the original value.
The server, acting as a gateway, received an invalid response from an upstream service. The right status when the BFF's backend fails.
